newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saab starts direct Japanese marketing.
newsitem.headline: Saab starts direct Japanese marketing.

text.p: Saab Automobile AB, the Swedish unit of General Motors Corp (GM), said on Tuesday it had started to market and service its cars by itself in Japan.
Since October 1992, Saab cars were imported and sold in Japan by Mizwa International, a unit of Mizwa Motor Co Ltd, the sole agent in Japan for Porsche AG cars.
General Motors Japan Co Ltd, GM's Japanese unit, began selling and servicing the cars on Tuesday through its Saab Japan unit, which was formed today.
Saab Japan plans to increase its sales outlets to between 100 to 120 over the next few years from the present 74.
Sales of Saabs in 1995 fell 20.5 percent from a year earlier to 1,352 units, and were down 22 percent to 719 units in the January-August period compared to the same period last year.
